gate.conditions: Historical evidence has not yet been entered in the detailed inventory.
Testing evidence and reviewer outcomes must be entered before a deployment recommendation is recorded.

technicalRisks.title: Policy-answer accuracy and grounding
technicalRisks.scenario: Pending assessment: the assistant could provide an inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated interpretation of an approved policy.
technicalRisks.mitigation: Assessment plan: confirm approved grounding sources, version control, citations, response limitations, escalation to authoritative policy owners, acceptance thresholds, and representative testing.
technicalRisks.decision: Assessment required before a deployment recommendation.

technicalRisks.title: Unauthorized policy-content retrieval or disclosure
technicalRisks.scenario: Pending assessment: retrieval or access configuration could expose content beyond the intended user's authorization or the chatbot's approved scope.
technicalRisks.mitigation: Assessment plan: document source classification and ownership, enforce least privilege and retrieval authorization, minimize stored data, and test access boundaries and leakage scenarios.
technicalRisks.decision: Assessment required before a deployment recommendation.

technicalRisks.title: Prompt injection and manipulation
technicalRisks.scenario: Pending assessment: malicious or unintended instructions could cause the assistant to ignore approved behavior, reveal protected context, or produce unsafe output.
technicalRisks.mitigation: Assessment plan: define input and output safeguards, instruction hierarchy, content boundaries, abuse-case testing, safe refusal behavior, logging, alerting, and response procedures.
technicalRisks.decision: Assessment required before a deployment recommendation.

technicalRisks.title: Integration, network, and service availability
technicalRisks.scenario: Pending assessment: dependency, integration, connectivity, capacity, or service failure could make the assistant unavailable or produce incomplete responses.
technicalRisks.mitigation: Assessment plan: document dependencies and connectivity, define timeouts and failure behavior, establish capacity and availability targets, test recovery, and confirm monitoring and escalation.
technicalRisks.decision: Assessment required before a deployment recommendation.

technicalRisks.title: Uncontrolled model, platform, or vendor change
technicalRisks.scenario: Pending assessment: a model, platform, dependency, API, or vendor change could alter behavior, controls, cost, or supportability without appropriate review and retesting.
technicalRisks.mitigation: Assessment plan: establish version inventory, change notification, impact review, regression testing, approval, rollback, and periodic reassessment requirements.
technicalRisks.decision: Assessment required before a deployment recommendation.

decisions.decision: Use the HR Policy Chatbot as the pilot for detailed AI Inventory tracking.
decisions.conditions: Do not infer or publish unverified approvals; enter public-safe evidence as it is confirmed.
